versions.changelog: Added setup section, fixed dead link

- Initial release of the social-intelligence skill.
- Provides AI-powered social media research across Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit with 1.5B+ posts indexed.
- Enables search, lead generation, brand monitoring, sentiment analysis, influencer discovery, and CSV export.
- Integrates multiple specialized skills (e.g., expert-finder, social-lead-gen, social-sentiment) under a single MCP backend.
- Simple setup with OAuth authentication via xpoz-setup skill.
- Free tier available; supports scalable exports for in-depth analysis.
